description: Propose an address for the owner to approve: one of the owner's own receiving addresses (for pay links) or the address of someone the owner pays (for drafts). It is saved unapproved and the owner gets an email. On accounts with the policy ApprovedOnly, API keys can only use approved addresses, and only the owner can approve one, signed in to the send21 app with a passkey or authenticator code. No key can approve an address. Requires scope addressbook:write.

address.description: The address, or for BTC over Lightning the Lightning address (name@wallet.com)

direction.description: Receiving (default): the owner's own address, for pay links. Sending: someone the owner pays, for drafts.

label.description: A label the owner will recognise, e.g. "My Phantom wallet" (unique per account)

network.description: Network the address lives on: Mainnet (Bitcoin, also for Lightning addresses), Solana, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum or Polygon

name: propose_receiving_address
